summary.zh: 先投入稀缺材料，换取更快或更优的收成。
summary.en: Invest scarce materials before harvesting for faster or better returns.

rules.zh: 玩家在播种前后按规则给地块施肥，用材料成本换取成长或品质收益。不同肥效不一定可叠加，土地闲置和换季也可能影响保留，反馈来自实际收获时间与产物。
rules.en: Apply fertilizer under the planting rules, exchanging material cost for growth or quality. Effects may be mutually exclusive, and idle land or season changes can affect persistence; harvest timing and output reveal the benefit.

loop.zh: 核对增益是否抵过成本
loop.en: Compare the benefit with its cost

decisions.zh: 追求高品质售价，还是提前收获再种一轮，取决于剩余时间。
decisions.en: Higher-quality sales or an earlier extra harvest depends on the time remaining.

decisions.zh: 贵作物更容易覆盖肥料成本，但也把更多价值押在一块田上。
decisions.en: Valuable crops justify fertilizer more easily but concentrate investment in one plot.

effect.zh: 提速改变日程，提质改变出售或加工选择。
effect.en: Speed changes scheduling; quality changes sale and processing choices.

effect.zh: 长期保留鼓励固定田块，易失效则要求持续投入。
effect.en: Persistent fertilizer favors permanent plots; expiring effects require ongoing investment.

contrast.zh: 前者提供多种目标的横向选择；后者让投入价值随首次成熟与再生阶段而变化。
contrast.en: The former offers alternative goals; the latter changes the value of investment between initial growth and regrowth.

combination.zh: 设计提案：肥料来自不同区域的采集物，每种改变作物一个属性，形成供应链选择。
combination.en: Design proposal: fertilizers use materials from different regions, each changing one crop trait and creating sourcing choices.

setup.zh: 你只够买一种肥料：提早2天成熟，或提高收获品质。
setup.en: You can buy one fertiliser: mature two days earlier, or improve crop quality.

action.zh: 季末将近，你选提速肥料，争取再收一轮。
action.en: With the season ending, choose faster growth to fit one more harvest.

result.zh: 单次售价没提高，但多出的收获可能补回肥料钱。
result.en: The sale price stays the same, but the extra harvest may repay the fertiliser cost.

next.zh: 换到季初后重新算账，未必仍选同一种肥料。
next.en: Recalculate at the start of the next season; the best choice may change.

firstStep.zh: 先做一种作物、两种互斥肥料，结算时列出投入、收获次数和净收益。
firstStep.en: Use one crop and two mutually exclusive fertilisers. Show spending, harvest count and net return.

pitfall.zh: 避免把所有肥效都做成可叠加的增产百分比，否则只剩有钱就买的选择。
pitfall.en: Stackable percentage bonuses can reduce the decision to buying every affordable upgrade.

test.zh: 用季初和季末两个场景，检查玩家选择是否改变，并能解释原因。
test.en: Test early- and late-season scenarios; see whether choices change for understandable reasons.
